_README: Outreach contact ledger — see SKILL.md Step 2 (dedupe) and Step 6 (recording).
One entry per person ACTUALLY EMAILED, appended only after the operator confirms
they sent the batch. Never written at draft time: a draft that gets reviewed and
deleted was never sent, and recording it would exclude that person forever.
Fields are user_id, cohort, sent_on — and nothing else. This repo is public, so
the ledger holds only opaque row ids, which are meaningless without the production
database. Do not add handles, names, or email addresses to make it readable.
This is one of three dedupe sources, unioned: this file, Gmail sent mail, and
pending drafts. If any of them says someone has been written to, skip them.
